trimmingSuggestions.description: The opening scene could be trimmed by removing some of the initial polite conversation about tea and sugar. This would bring the focus to the growing tension between June and Mrs. Croft.

The wedding scene (Scene 2) could be shortened to highlight the key moments of the couple's appearance and the discussion about the lost soldier. This would make it more impactful as a contrast to the first scene.
